description: Basic monitoring and operational tooling - Add Sentry error tracking to backend and frontend, implement structured logging with request IDs, create health check dashboard page, and add basic Prometheus metrics endpoint.
steps: Add @sentry/react==7.99.0 to frontend/package.json and run npm install
Create backend/app/core/monitoring.py initializing Sentry with DSN from SENTRY_DSN environment variable (optional, only if configured)
Initialize Sentry in backend/main.py during app startup if SENTRY_DSN is set
Initialize Sentry in frontend/src/main.tsx with VITE_SENTRY_DSN environment variable
Add request_id generation middleware to backend/main.py (UUID per request, added to context and response headers)
Update backend logging format to include request_id in all log statements (modify logging config in main.py)
Create backend/app/api/v1/monitoring.py with /monitoring/health endpoint returning detailed health status (postgres, redis, minio connectivity)
Create frontend/src/pages/MonitoringDashboard.tsx page showing system health, provider status, and recent errors (fetches from /monitoring/health)
Add Prometheus metrics endpoint using prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator==6.1.0 in backend at /metrics path
Update frontend/src/App.tsx to add route for /monitoring page
Create backend/tests/test_monitoring.py testing health endpoint returns correct status, metrics endpoint returns Prometheus format
acceptance_criteria: Sentry SDK integrated in both backend and frontend (only initializes if DSN configured)
All backend requests have unique request_id in logs and X-Request-ID response header
GET /api/v1/monitoring/health returns JSON with postgres, redis, minio health status
GET /metrics endpoint returns Prometheus-formatted metrics (http_requests_total, etc.)
Frontend /monitoring page displays system health dashboard with status indicators
Backend exceptions automatically sent to Sentry (if configured)
Frontend errors automatically sent to Sentry (if configured)
Request IDs visible in all backend log output
verification: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt (installs sentry-sdk and prometheus-instrumentator)
Start backend without SENTRY_DSN (no errors, Sentry not initialized)
curl -I http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health | grep 'X-Request-ID' (request ID header present)
Check backend logs for request_id field in JSON output
